args.actions: Noticed entities jump from 24 to 2340 and declared an incident. Read the logs and listed pig positions. Ran "kill @e[type=item]" and "kill @e[type=pig,name=!Wilbur]". The item kill removed all dropped items, including any a player had dropped legitimately; I can't tell whether there were any beyond the flood. I assumed the named pig Wilbur was the original pig and spared it. The pig kill was name-based, and the entity count after it matches the baseline of 24.
